scope: Proposition 4.1 of the manuscript “A proof of Seymour’s second-neighborhood conjecture” (preprints/A-proof-of-Seymours-second-neighborhood-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 173 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 20be859799f83e34), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is no nonempty finite oriented graph G in which every vertex has an in-neighbor and whose one-step image operator F(U) = {y ∈ V (G) : x → y for some x ∈ U} satisfies |U| + |F2 (U)| < 2|F(U)| (∅ ̸= U ⊊ V (G)), (17) where F2 = F ◦ F.
